Watcom loop-unrolled memcpy (countdown for-loop with the `(uint)bool * -N + M` direction idiom — Watcom's REP MOVSD lowering fingerprint). Replace the whole loop with memcpy(dst, src, count * stride) or a struct assignment in a .keep.

Unrolled-memcpy loop reads 6 elements from local array `auStack_5c[4]` (declared size 4) — overruns by 2. Likely Ghidra dropped explicit `auStack_5c[k] = ...` stores before the copy, OR the asm has an off-by-one REP MOVSD count. Fix in a .keep by restoring all stores and using a properly-sized memcpy or struct assignment.
